<?import javafx.scene.layout.StackPane?>
<?import javafx.scene.control.Button?>
<?import javafx.scene.control.Label?>
<?import javafx.geometry.Insets?>

<BorderPane xmlns="http://javafx.com/javafx"
            xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml"
            fx:controller="com.example.ui.CatalogueController"
            prefWidth="1920" prefHeight="1080"
            styleClass="screen">

    <!-- TOP BAR -->
    <top>
        <VBox spacing="12">
            <padding>
                <Insets top="24" right="28" bottom="10" left="28"/>
            </padding>

            <HBox alignment="CENTER_LEFT" spacing="16">
                <Button text="≡" styleClass="iconBtn"/>
                <Label text="Menu" styleClass="title"/>
                <StackPane HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"/>
                <Label fx:id="totalLabel" text="0,00 €" styleClass="total"/>
            </HBox>

            <!-- Onglets catégories -->
            <HBox spacing="14">
                <Button fx:id="tabEntrees" text="Entrées" styleClass="tab" onAction="#onEntrees"/>
                <Button fx:id="tabPlats" text="Plats" styleClass="tab" onAction="#onPlats"/>
                <Button fx:id="tabDesserts" text="Desserts" styleClass="tab" onAction="#onDesserts"/>
                <Button fx:id="tabBoissons" text="Boissons" styleClass="tab" onAction="#onBoissons"/>
            </HBox>
        </VBox>
    </top>

    <!-- CENTER: Grid 2x2 -->
    <center>
        <GridPane fx:id="grid" hgap="26" vgap="26">
            <padding>
                <Insets top="18" right="28" bottom="18" left="28"/>
            </padding>
        </GridPane>
    </center>

    <!-- BOTTOM BAR -->
    <bottom>
        <HBox alignment="CENTER_LEFT">
            <padding>
                <Insets top="10" right="28" bottom="24" left="28"/>
            </padding>

            <Button text="Accueil" styleClass="ghostBtn" onAction="#onBackAccueil"/>
            <StackPane HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"/>
            <Button text="Panier" styleClass="ctaSmall" onAction="#onOpenPanier"/>
        </HBox>
    </bottom>

</BorderPane>
